title: Coefficient4 logarithmic-divisor family with exact weak-seed precision

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Fixed total family.py;N<128 or failed guards output0. Let L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),D=max(2,z),C=2^30; Gamma code of S>0 has H=2floor(log2S)+1 bits;malformed/S>2^L rejects. With P2:j0=max(1,ceil(log2z)),a=P2(max(2,floor(z^3/j0))),j=log2a,Bc=ceil(5L/j),bits3j,3j+1,3j+2 of S-1 decode U-1,V-1,T-1,h=P2(UL^2),e=P2(VL^2z),ell=P2(128ze),q0=(2ha+Cez^2+10)ell,eprime=100ha*ell+e+2,d=16q0+128eprime+128L+1280,Y=100Bc*hd+Cez^2d,k=hY+100Bc*ha*ell+10d+Cez^2ell. Rejecta>h. Initial A1D11 outputsP2(Y),explicitY-bit prefix;precisionceil(L/28)+10,adaptiveB1,exact reconstructionfield,seedcap5L. Ordered base-a words give ceil(d0/j) index rounds,a<=h. Four internal B2.1maps have dimensionD,K=C*e*z^2*M,at most2 eventual calls,stipulated seedell. C6 raises four field degrees to maxs_star,rechecks advice/seed,and uses ONE paid C5 package of t_star-a(t_star)bits,t_star=D*s_star,a(t)=floor(log2(floor(log2t)-1)) for t>=32,elsemin(2,t). C5/C3 decode/compile once. Own nprime,H,m0,error/calls remain;bad data yieldzero/ring maps. Good primitive data work universally. Short E1 is direct B2.3,no data. Initial and B5data are canonical by C1 bounded exhaustive search. B5 uses the supplied A2 entropy sampler,directA1D4 helper,weak shared hash and bounded fresh-seed rounds,with exact constants in family.py/proofs. Prefixdegree1000w/output250w gives shifted agreement. CompleteG is nonlinear; only strong general extraction/shifted agreement are used. Layoutdelta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(T*w/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10,w=ceil(log2 r). All headers/data are handled by one polynomial-time program. Fixed goodS0 is paid. Eventuald0<4L,P=O_S0(L^2z^2)=o(k),initialbad2N^(-1/28) and S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) close the all-length bound. Each biased group uses firstu bits of ONE completed row,ell>=u;capacityB*M<=2^d0. B6 needsO(r^2) goodROW independence and O(r^2u) errorlog,paid separately byh,e.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^5/log2(log2(log2 N)). For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^(5+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(9+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed gamma header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*(ceil(log2 L))^2)=o(k), including the shared growing-dimension package serving all four maps. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2) ROW independence and O(r^2*u) log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed. C16 sets integer eprime=100h*a*ell+e+2. E1 weak-seed rank failure is at most2^(100haell+1-eprime)=2^(-e-1). At the SAME fixed good packed code,let F=100B_cap*h+Cez^2 and Delta=P2(512haell+4e)-eprime>=412haell. Old allocated k minus current k is EXACTLY128(hF+10)Delta. Paid prefixes are both O(L^2z^2),so current certified loss is strictly smaller eventually by Omega(L^9z^5/(log2z)^2). Fields/layout may differ. The full divisor theorem and native4,1 remain.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Exact weak-seed precision and integer budget-difference comparisons with retained focused entropy,packed-scale,prefix,index,header,shared-field,codec and arithmetic checks. Retired source summaries are omitted from disperser.md. Finite checks do not prove B4 or the universal theorem.
